title: Chemical Drain Cleaners Fix Clogged Drainage Systems
description: Chemical drain cleaners are often marketed as a quick fix for clogged plumbing, but they can cause severe damage to your drainage system. Acidic or caustic chemicals create intense exothermic reactions that can soften, warp, or crack PVC pipes, corrode older cast iron lines, and degrade rubber seals. Furthermore, if the chemical fails to clear the obstruction, it leaves a standing pool of hazardous liquid inside the pipe, creating a safety hazard for plumbers attempting mechanical clearing. Mechanical snaking or hydro-jetting remains the professional standard for removing drain blockages safely and effectively.
